messages:
Alex R: Heads-up — Product wants a Console panel showing continuous-batching / queueing metrics (batch size distribution, wait times, saturation indicators). Need runtime + infra inputs on exact metric names, labels, and reasonable buckets. @Kevin @Maria @Sanjay can you weigh in?

Kevin T: Quick context: runtime already emits a per-worker `batch_size` gauge and a `batch_wait_ms` histogram internally, but it's host-scoped and uses inconsistent buckets. We need service-level histograms and a way to aggregate across workers.

Maria L: For platform/console we need low-cardinality labels: `model`, `route`, `env` (prod/stage), `tier` (hosted/dedicated). Avoid raw `customer_id` on metrics; use `customer_hash` if necessary. Also prefer histogram metrics over summary for cross-aggregation.

Sanjay P: Infra preference: OTLP -> metrics pipeline -> Cortex/Prometheus remote write. Prometheus histograms or OpenTelemetry histograms that translate to histogram buckets are best. We should pick canonical bucket boundaries. High-cardinality labels (like route+model_variant+customer_hash) must be evaluated for cardinality explosion.

Jess (product): From UX side we want: p50/p90/p99 wait time, heatmap of batch size distribution over time (stacked by batch size ranges), a saturation indicator: % of batches that hit max_batch_size per minute, and queue_depth trend. Alerts: saturation >80% for 5m, queue_depth > X per worker.

Kevin T: Suggested metric names + types (proposal):
- `redwood_batch_size` (histogram) buckets: 1,2,4,8,16,32,64,128
- `redwood_batch_wait_seconds` (histogram) buckets: 0.0001,0.001,0.005,0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1,5
- `redwood_inflight_batches` (gauge)
- `redwood_queue_depth` (gauge) per-worker/queue
- `redwood_batch_count` (counter) per bucket label `le` for histogram compatibility
- `redwood_batches_maxed_ratio` (gauge) ratio of batches that were full / total batches (0..1)

Kevin T: Labels: `model`, `route`, `env`, `tier`, `worker_id`, `shard_id`. Keep `worker_id` but make it nullable for aggregated views. Also `priority` for traffic tier (normal/high).

Maria L: For Console rollouts we also need `route_id` passed through the internal API. SDKs should add a metric label header like `X-RW-Route: <route_id>` so runtime can attach the label. We should update the internal API/SDK PRD.

Sanjay P: Implementation plan (infra): runtime emits OTLP histograms with suggested buckets. Pipeline transforms `worker_id` -> `instance` label, strips `customer_id` if present, and forwards to Cortex. Grafana dashboards will query aggregated metrics and compute `maxed_ratio` as `sum(batch_count{le="<max_bucket>"}) / sum(batch_count_total)` or using `redwood_batches_maxed_ratio` if runtime emits directly.

Alex R: Kevin, are the suggested buckets OK? Any perf impact of histogram cardinality?

Kevin T: Buckets look sane. Cost-wise histograms add some telemetry but acceptable. Main risk is label cardinality. We'll emit with `shard_id` and `worker_id` but mark them as low-cardinality in docs and encourage console to aggregate away from worker-level by default.

Jess (product): For dashboards: wireframes need these panels — 1) real-time batch size histogram heatmap, 2) wait time p50/p90/p99 line chart, 3) saturation gauge + alert status, 4) queue depth stacked by shard. Will post mock tomorrow.

Maria L: Two API changes required: 1) runtime API to accept `route` header/metadata and attach to metrics, 2) agent/SDK to surface route in telemetry headers. I can own the SDK change, Kevin owns runtime.

Sanjay P: Timeline proposals: Kevin — instrument and emit histograms by EOW; Maria — SDK header change by next Tue; Infra/Grafana — draft dashboard in 2 weeks; Product — wireframe by Wed. If anyone needs more time, flag now.

Kevin T: I'll open a runtime PR today with the new Prometheus/OpenTelemetry metric names, and include a short sampling mode to limit cardinality during rollout. Example pseudo-instrumentation:
```
hist = otel.Histogram("redwood_batch_wait_seconds", buckets=[0.0001,0.001,0.005,0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5,1,5])
labels = {"model": model_name, "route": route_id, "env": env, "tier": tier}
hist.record(wait_seconds, labels)
```

Maria L: +1 on sampling mode. We'll need a controlled rollout to avoid metric floods for large customers. Add a config flag `metrics.route_cardinality_limit` or sampling_rate.

Alex R: Action items summary:
- Kevin T: runtime instrumentation + PR (histograms + labels) — owner, EOW
- Maria L: SDK header & docs for `route` label — owner, next Tue
- Sanjay P: pipeline + Grafana dashboard skeleton — owner, 2w
- Jess (product): dashboard wireframe — owner, Wed

Alex R: Thanks everyone. Please post PR links and mockups in this thread so Console/Platform can start wiring up panels. :thumbsup:
